description:
Every shop's price to make a custom part, at the shop's own rates. process: 'cnc' (milled) or 'turn'.
    material as a shop lists it ('Aluminum 6061-T6'). part: {"name", "file": a model's file id from upload_file, and
    "print": a PDF print's file id} (best: priced from Cliff's own machining plan), or {"name", "measures": {"box_mm":
    [x, y, z], "volume_mm3", "surface_mm2", "holes", "tolerance_mm"}} (rougher). Each quote: status (firm: the shop's
    own rules accept it now; estimate: the shop confirms), prices at other quantities, lead times, and the shop's
    record of holding its estimates; each shop that cannot make it says why. Nothing is ranked. Needs an API key.
name: quote_made_part
